FINAL SAVED TEXT
1. Notes (1891 chars):
---
No sign-in needed to try the app.
The app opens on the scene library. The scenes in the Catalog can be downloaded without an account. Open a scene, run the table read, tap Record to record your lines, then watch the dubbed scene in the screening room. Takes are saved on the device; WAV export and sharing a scene file (.take) work from there.

Reviewer account, for the account-based features.
Sign in from Settings with reviewer@badtakes.io and the code in the Password field of this section. Both are fixed and always work, unlike the emailed code a real account gets. Signing in adds Collab (hosting or joining a shared room to record a scene with other people) and a public @handle. Accounts are free; there is nothing to buy and no plan tiers.

No purchases, subscriptions or ads.
This build sells nothing and shows no ads.

Content.
The Catalog holds three short, widely shared clips from local TV news reports, used as dubbing material. We remove any scene at a rights holder's request via the contact address below. Every other scene in the app is imported by the user from their own files. The app bundles no audio or video.

User-generated content.
Collab rooms are recordings made together by people who hold the same scene. Rooms are joined by a code the host shares; nothing is listed publicly. Recordings are shared only inside the room. Reports go to elugo25111@gmail.com; we act on them within 24 hours, and a room can be ended by its host at any time.

Missing menu items are deliberate.
Video export, Vertical reel and Edit need a server-side rendering service that is not part of this build, so they are hidden on iOS. WAV export and sharing a scene file both work.

Permissions.
The microphone is requested when you first press Record. The camera is off by default and opt-in from the recording screen. The app requests no location permission and no tracking permission.
---
